title: Practice-Location Effect on Consistency
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:session
| stats sum(eval(if(completed="yes",1,0))) as completed, count as planned by location
| eval completion_pct=round(100*completed/planned,1)
| sort - completion_pct
description: Shows whether certain locations make spiritual practices easier to complete consistently.
value: Environment matters; identifying supportive places can improve consistency without requiring more willpower.
implementation: Capture planned and completed sessions with location labels and compute completion percentage by location.
visualization: Table of practice locations by completion percentage.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which places make it easier for you to actually follow through on your practice.
